name: Flask of Natural Precision
tooltip:
Flask of Natural Precision
Item Level 60
Requires Level 55

Use: Increases your Stamina by 60. While in Mount Hyjal, Hyjal Summit, and the Barrow Deeps, you also gain 5% reduced chance to be dodged or parried.

Lasts for 2 hrs. You can only have the effect of one flask at a time. This effect persists through death. (3 Sec Cooldown)
Max Stack: 20
Sell Price: 50
